content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced in-store sales and merchandising services for consumer brands, not owning or selling out-of-home ad displays."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Holding company mixing billboards with broadband and insurance; billboards are only one segment of its business."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Owns and sells billboard, transit and airport display advertising to brands and agencies, matching OUTFRONT's core business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Runs B2B trade shows and events earning booth and registration fees, not out-of-home advertising displays."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Freight trucking and intermodal transportation for shippers, with no advertising display business."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Publishes newspapers and sells print and digital subscriptions and ads, a different media format from out-of-home displays."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Agency network providing creative, media and consulting services for fees, not owning ad display space."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Office building landlord leasing space to corporate tenants, with no advertising display business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Marketing and advertising agency network selling creative and campaign services, not owned display inventory."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Programmatic digital ad-buying software platform charging fees on spend, not owning physical display assets."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Owns radio stations and a cable network selling audience airtime; broadcast media differs from out-of-home displays."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Programmatic digital advertising software and managed campaigns, with no owned physical display inventory."}]}
